Actor Dulquer Salmaan questioned in SUV smuggling probe

Actor Dulquer Salmaan was questioned by Customs officials in connection with 'Operation Numkhor'. The operation is reportedly investigating an alleged SUV smuggling racket. The details of the questioning and the extent of Salmaan's involvement, if any, remain unclear.
